# temps_email_domain_project (Resource)

Authorizes a project to send email from a `temps_email_domain`.

Import with `<email_domain_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `email_domains:read`, `email_domains:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_email_domain_project" "web" {
  email_domain_id = temps_email_domain.mail.id
  project_id      = temps_project.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email_domain_id` (Number) ID of the email domain.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<email_domain_id>/<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <email_domain_id>/<project_id>
terraform import temps_email_domain_project.web 3/8
```
